# gns3_compute (Data Source)

Looks up a compute registered with the GNS3 controller by `compute_id` or `name`. Exactly one must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gns3_compute" "local" {
  compute_id = "local"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `compute_id` (String) Compute identifier, for example `local` or `vm`.
- `name` (String) Compute name. Must match exactly one compute.

### Read-Only

- `connected` (Boolean) Whether the controller is connected to the compute.
- `host` (String) Compute host.
- `port` (Number) Compute port.
- `protocol` (String) `http` or `https`.
